mapper.insert: INSERT INTO migration_task (name, mode, state, source_connection_id, target_connection_id, tables_json, options_json) VALUES (#{name}, #{mode}, #{state}, #{sourceConnectionId}, #{targetConnectionId}, #{tablesJson, typeHandler=io.opendrs.migration.mapper.type.TableSelectionTypeHandler}, #{optionsJson, typeHandler=io.opendrs.migration.mapper.type.MigrationOptionsTypeHandler})
mapper.select: SELECT id, name, mode, state, source_connection_id, target_connection_id, tables_json, options_json, tables_total, tables_done, rows_done, lag_ms, error_message, created_at, updated_at FROM migration_task WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, name, mode, state, source_connection_id, target_connection_id, tables_json, options_json, tables_total, tables_done, rows_done, lag_ms, error_message, created_at, updated_at FROM migration_task WHERE name = #{name}

SELECT id, name, mode, state, source_connection_id, target_connection_id, tables_json, options_json, tables_total, tables_done, rows_done, lag_ms, error_message, created_at, updated_at FROM migration_task ORDER BY id
mapper.update: UPDATE migration_task SET state = #{state}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE migration_task SET state = 'FAILED', error_message = #{errorMessage}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
